::: {#sylassessment .sec}

## Assessment Policies

<ul class="policy-list">
<li><strong>Quiz aids:</strong> non-programmable calculator only; necessary reference tables are supplied.</li>
<li><strong>Regrades:</strong> request through Quercus within three working days of release, identifying a marking error.</li>
<li><strong>Missed quizzes:</strong> no make-ups. With an approved petition, the first missed quiz receives the average of completed quizzes; later approved absences transfer the missed quiz's weight to the final.</li>
<li><strong>Missed final:</strong> petition for a deferred examination.</li>
</ul>

<p><a href="index.html#coursework">Assessment weights and quiz dates</a></p>

:::


::: {#syltentsch .sec}

## Course Outline

1. Complex numbers and elementary complex functions
2. Ordinary differential equations
3. Laplace transform
4. Complex functions and analyticity
5. Contour integration
6. Complex series
7. Residue theory and inverse Laplace transformation

<p><a href="index.html#schedule">Readings and homework for all 36 lectures</a></p>

:::


::: {#syltextbook .sec}

## Readings and Preparation

Use **Zill, 7th edition**, together with the course notes listed on the <a href="index.html#materials">materials page</a>. Work through the assigned problems before tutorial. The ODE unit uses separate notes, whose section numbers and exercises are identified explicitly in the schedule.

:::


::: {#sylpolicies .sec}
